newsitem.title: USA: NorAm responds to FERC on Houston.
newsitem.headline: NorAm responds to FERC on Houston.

text.p: NorAm Energy Corp's NorAm Energy Services Inc subsidiary filed a response with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Friday stating its view that FERC does not have jurisdiction over the merger of its parent company with Houston Industries Inc.

On February 5, FERC issued an order requiring NorAm either to file a response within 30 days stating why it believes FERC does not have jurisdiction under the Federal Power Act over the merger, or to file an application for approval of the merger.

In its response filed today, NorAm pointed out that its merger is unique in that neither NorAm nor Houston Industries is subject to the jurisdiction of FERC. NorAm has no electric utility operations, and Houston Lighting & Power Co operates entirely in Texas and is not a public utility under the FPA.
Nvertheless, the companies said that one of the options being considered is to file an application with FERC for approval of the merger in anticipation of an expedited review.
The companies said they expect to decide in the near future the course to be pursued.
